card.name: Quantity words before units like octave
card.fires_on: Numbers or quantity words (a digit, two, many, few, same, one) placed just before a unit of measure such as decibels, km, f-stops, miles, hours or Hz. It fires on the quantity, where a unit word is expected next.

modes.label: Digits inside a number
modes.description: A digit within a multi-digit figure, before a unit or percent.
modes.example: patients experience up to <<6>>7% less sensitivity

modes.label: Quantity word before a unit
modes.description: Words like two, many, few, same or one right before a measurement unit.
modes.example: how<< many>> decibels can a singer

modes.label: Number before a distance
modes.description: A single digit followed by a distance unit.
modes.example: The top of the storm rises <<8>> km above surrounding clouds.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'oct' (octave) style continuations and away from 'round' words, hinting at a measure-unit word coming next.
card.plain: It marks a number or amount word that is about to be followed by a unit of measurement, such as decibels or miles.
